name: final_sudoku_benchmark_with_hint_solver_difficulty
description: A dataset of Sudoku puzzles annotated with solver hints and difficulty labels intended to evaluate models' logical problem-solving and stepwise reasoning capabilities. It measures whether a model can produce a correct completed grid (or next-step solutions) given a puzzle and optional hints, across multiple difficulty tiers. Useful for assessing planning, constraint reasoning, and multi-step deduction in models.
evaluation_method: exact_match / accuracy (correct completed grid or exactly correct next-move)
general_score_metric: exact_match (percentage of fully correct solved puzzles)
typical_sota_score: varies by difficulty; roughly 20–80% overall depending on model and hinting regime
reputation: A niche benchmark used in reasoning and symbolic-problem-solving evaluations; moderate adoption among researchers probing multi-step reasoning.
